## c1
skills: Coordination, Public speaking

**Assertion:** Ran the campus placement drive for the computing branches.

**Evidence:** The cell had one staff member and no student side before this. I took
the company scheduling, which had been a shared spreadsheet nobody owned, and ran it
as one calendar. Six branches, and about forty companies visited over the year, out
of the sixty we wrote to. The thing that would have cost us most was a clash on a
visit day, which is why the calendar had one owner.
